threat_event: Attacker controlling a client's email account asks for an urgent wire to a new bank account; the owner submits it to the custodian and the client's money is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No callback rule; custodian e-signature link goes to the same compromised email address; urgency and familiarity with the client; near miss on 2026-06-18 stopped only by the custodian
affected_asset_or_process: BP-02 money movement; SYS-01; SYS-04; SYS-06
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (2026-06-18 near miss); EV-004 (requests sent for e-signature with no recorded call); EV-014 (signing links go to the email on file); EV-028 (no business email compromise training)
existing_controls: Custodian review and callback on some third-party wires
treatment_plan: Callback to the phone number on file in the CRM before submitting any money movement request received by email or text (POL-01 7.6); no changes to bank instructions by email alone; letter to clients explaining the rule; annual business email compromise training

threat_event: Takeover of the owner's email account exposes every client's statements and onboarding forms and lets the attacker impersonate the adviser to clients and the custodian
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on the email tenant administrator account; password reused on two other sites; no review of sign-ins or forwarding rules; an unrecognized forwarding rule was found on 2026-07-15
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 email and files; BP-02; BP-03
likelihood_basis: EV-010 (password-only tenant administrator mailbox; no review record); EV-016 (password reused on two other sites); EV-AU-6 (unrecognized forwarding rule, P07 test 2026-07-15)
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA (authenticator app) and a unique passphrase in a password manager; sign out all sessions; monthly review of sign-ins and rules (POL-01 7.8)

threat_event: Takeover of the CRM, portfolio platform, or e-signature account exposes SSNs, ID images, and account numbers of about 160 consumers or allows forged fee or signature activity
threat_source: Cybercriminal (credential stuffing with a reused password)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA available but off on all three; one password pattern across services
likelihood_basis: EV-006 (portfolio platform MFA off); EV-009 (CRM MFA off; SSNs and ID images for about 160 consumers); EV-014 (e-signature MFA off); EV-016 (one password pattern)
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA for the CRM, portfolio platform, e-signature, and accounting SaaS; password manager with unique passphrases

threat_event: The unencrypted USB backup drive is lost or stolen, exposing a full copy of every client folder
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drive not encrypted; kept in an unlocked desk drawer; sometimes carried in a laptop bag
likelihood_basis: EV-019 (drive unencrypted; full copy of client folders); EV-021 (unlocked desk drawer); EV-033 (drive sometimes carried in the laptop bag)
treatment_plan: Replace with an encrypted drive, wipe the old one, and keep the new one in the home safe; add an encrypted cloud backup (R-008)

threat_event: The owner-adviser is suddenly unavailable (illness, injury, death) or loses the only phone, so no one can trade, answer clients, or reach the custodian portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single person holds every role and credential; custodian MFA on one phone; no successor adviser arrangement
likelihood_basis: EV-001 (one second-factor device); EV-030 (no employees); EV-027 (no successor arrangement found); EV-032 (BIA worksheet)
existing_controls: Clients can reach the custodian directly for withdrawals
treatment_plan: Written arrangement with another Florida-registered adviser; sealed recovery codes and emergency access sheet with the owner's attorney; hardware security key as a second MFA method (P05)

threat_event: Client statements with account numbers pasted into a consumer AI assistant are kept or used to train models by the vendor, outside any contract
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consumer terms allow model training; no contract requiring safeguards; about 25 client households' statements pasted between 2026-05-04 and 2026-07-15
likelihood_basis: EV-022 (statements for about 25 households; training setting on); EV-023 (consumer terms allow training)
treatment_plan: Do not resume the consumer plan; delete chat history and turn off training; counsel reviews whether Florida notice is needed; any future tool only on a business plan with no-training terms and no account numbers (P10)

threat_event: A service provider mishandles client files because no contract requires safeguards (compliance consultant, CRM and e-signature vendors unreviewed)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Compliance consultant receives client files by ordinary email and has no security terms; no vendor list or periodic review
likelihood_basis: EV-025 (compliance consultant letter without security terms; no vendor list or review); EV-012 (client files sent as attachments)
existing_controls: IT consultant agreement with security terms (2026-07-10); email and portfolio platform terms
treatment_plan: Vendor list; security and confidentiality terms with the compliance consultant; share files through expiring links instead of attachments; annual vendor review

threat_event: Ransomware from a phishing email encrypts the laptop, the synced client folders, and the USB copy that is plugged in during the weekly backup
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sync spreads encrypted files to the cloud; only 30 days of versions; USB drive connected while copying; no training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07 laptop and USB; SYS-04 files
likelihood_basis: EV-017 (sync folder holds client documents); EV-010 (30-day versions; no backup service); EV-019 (drive connected during the copy); EV-028 (no security training)
existing_controls: Built-in antivirus; automatic updates; laptop encryption (does not stop ransomware)
treatment_plan: Encrypted backup of mail and files to a second cloud location with 1-year retention; USB drive disconnected except during the copy; annual training

threat_event: A family member's device or a smart-home device on the shared home network, or family use of the laptop, exposes client data
threat_source: Accidental (family use) or malware on another device
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One network for family, smart-home, and business devices; default router admin password; family member uses the laptop under the owner's account
likelihood_basis: EV-020 (shared network; default router password); EV-017 (family use of the owner's account; host firewall on)
existing_controls: Laptop encryption and host firewall; SaaS traffic uses TLS
treatment_plan: Change the router admin password now; separate business network; laptop for business use only (POL-01 7.4)

threat_event: A security incident is not recognized, or the Florida 30-day individual notice deadline is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact list, or training; owner did not know the Florida clock
likelihood_basis: EV-027 (no incident plan or contact list found); EV-034 (owner did not know the Florida clock); EV-028 (no security training)
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and printed contact list; name breach counsel in advance; annual walkthrough

threat_event: Client records are lost or cannot be produced promptly when the Florida OFR asks in writing, risking summary suspension of the registration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention schedule; only 30-day versions and a weekly USB copy; records spread across services
likelihood_basis: EV-027 (no retention schedule or records index found); EV-010 (30-day versions); EV-019 (weekly USB copy)
existing_controls: Custodian statements and e-signature records can be re-downloaded
treatment_plan: Records index in POL-01 Appendix A; encrypted cloud backup (R-008); compliance consultant confirms the Rule 69W-600 record list and periods

threat_event: Records on former clients kept since 2015 enlarge any breach and the number of people to notify
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention or disposal schedule; old files in email, CRM, shared folders, USB drive
likelihood_basis: EV-009 (about 40 former clients in the CRM); EV-012 (former-client folders back to 2015); EV-027 (no retention or disposal schedule found)
treatment_plan: Retention schedule that keeps what Florida requires and deletes the rest; delete once a year each January

threat_event: The custodian or portfolio platform is down for longer than one trading day
likelihood_basis: EV-003 (custodian service desk takes phone orders); EV-008 (platform availability commitments)
existing_controls: Custodian adviser service desk takes phone orders; platform SOC 2 availability commitments (P09)
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Keep the custodian service desk number on the printed contact list

threat_event: A hurricane closes the home office or cuts power and internet for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single home office; paper files and devices on site
likelihood_basis: EV-026 (Florida principal office in the home); EV-021 (paper files and devices in the home office)
existing_controls: All systems are SaaS and reachable from anywhere with the laptop and phone
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Take the laptop, phone, and encrypted drive when an evacuation order is issued

threat_event: A client review letter drafted with AI help contains wrong figures or statements and is sent without being caught
threat_source: Owner error with an AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rule for checking AI-drafted text; drafts looked fluent and were lightly edited
likelihood_basis: EV-022 (review letters drafted with the assistant); EV-033 (drafts lightly edited); EV-027 (no rule for checking drafted text found)
existing_controls: Owner reads each letter before sending
treatment_plan: Every figure in an AI-assisted draft checked against the custodian statement; sample review each quarter (P10)
